newsitem.title: BELGIUM: KREDIETBANK TAKES STAKE IN SAN PAOLO.
newsitem.headline: KREDIETBANK TAKES STAKE IN SAN PAOLO.

text.p: Belgium's Kredietbank said on Thursday it has taken a two percent stake in Italy's Bancario San Paolo di Torino as part of its strategy of international expansion.
"The participation confirms the good relations between the two banking establishments," Kredietbank said in a statement.
"As a result, from 1998 Kredietbank will have a representative on the board of IBSPT (Bancario San Paolo di Torino), the leading Italian banking group," it added.

It said the participation in the Italian bank would involve two distinct phases. The first would consist of forming a stable group of strategic shareholders who would have an interest in around 20 percent of the bank, but not control.
During the second phase a further 25 percent of IBSPT would be publicly floated.

The group of strategic shareholders would include Italy's IFI SpA , Spain's Banco Santander , Italian banks Istituto Mobiliare Italiano SpA and Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena SpA and insurance firm Reale Mutua di Assicurazioni.
